name: Flipbook HTML5
description: transforms PDF file fields into interactive 3D flipbooks using PDF.js and PageFlip.
project_description:
Transform your PDF file display into interactive flipbooks with 3D animations and page turns, embedded directly into node pages. Beautiful, lightweight, and optimized for corporate networks.

 
 
 
 

 Key features include: 
 
 Zero server overhead: Renders binary files entirely via client-side JavaScript ( PDF.js and PageFlip ), preserving server CPU and memory resources. 
 Enhanced graphics: Includes a background design with pure, high-fidelity CSS texture panel for a premium reading experience. 
 Realistic physics: Each page with dynamic page density flexibility like a magazine. 
 Cross-browser stability: Fully compatible and optimized for rigorous corporate environments, including older and modern versions of Firefox/Chromium. 
 
 

 Quick guide: 
 

 
 Access the "Structure" menu and select the desired Content Type.

 
 
 Add a new file type field.

 
 
 In the "Manage Display" tab, in the Format column, select "Flipbook HTML5 Reader".
